about: bStocks: certificates issued by BTech Holdings Ltd (ADGM), recorded on BNB Chain, each a 1:1 entitlement to a US share held by Alpaca Securities LLC in the issuer’s segregated custody account. disclosures = the issuer’s weekly filing of certificates outstanding per ticker (ADGM public disclosures, as of Friday 23:59:59 UTC); readings = totalSupply() on BNB Chain each day for tokens whose address the issuer group has published; snapshots = supply rebuilt at each Friday 23:59:59 UTC; reconciliations = disclosed vs on chain at the same second. The shares at the custodian are not checked: no periodic independent attestation of them is published. Primary figures only; never aggregator data.
issuer: BTech Holdings Ltd (ADGM registration 36283), wholly owned by Binance Holdings

sources.proof_of_collateral_reading: The Proof of Collateral page lists each bStocks token with backing at 100%. Confirmed by the founder on 23 Oct 2026 that it names no third-party independent verifier: it is the issuer group’s own statement, not an attestation.
